diagnosis.observed: UAR log: 'Host-marked summarization failed; retaining originals' with error 'summarize eligible prose span canonical-prose-0-1' (attempt 3) and 'canonical-prose-2-3' (attempt 1). The span context wraps an error from summarize_span after the tier call completed. Attempt 3's single tier call returned 198 tokens against a summary budget of 200 minus replacement framing.
diagnosis.mechanism_from_source: src/uar/runtime/context/summarizer.rs summarize_span concatenates every MessageDelta into the summary and then checks the token count against the output ceiling (and non-emptiness). MiniMax-M3 through Liter streams inline <think> reasoning as MessageDelta text (established during the orchestrator-routing-reasoning-repair phase). The reasoning therefore counts as summary text and fills the small output allowance, so the summary exceeds its ceiling (198 > ~196) or would be reasoning-polluted; the whole summarization is discarded and the originals kept.
diagnosis.not_directly_observed: The summary text itself is not logged or receipted, and the inner error is hidden behind the outer context in the warn line; the exact failing check is inferred from the counts.
diagnosis.classification: product defect: reasoning text is treated as summary content and counted against the summary budget
diagnosis.proposed_minimal_fix: In summarize_span, pass the collected text through crate::llm::inline_reasoning::split_inline_reasoning (added in that phase): use only the answer part as the summary; fail with a named error when the reply ended inside reasoning or has no answer; apply the output-budget check to the answer only. Optionally log the full error chain (%error:#) at the warn site.
